transports.description: PostgreSQL MCP server (stdio via uvx). Requires DATABASE_URI.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query against the configured PostgreSQL database.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List all schemas in the database.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in a schema.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get column definitions, types, and constraints for a table.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Retrieve table/index statistics for performance analysis.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE) on a query to surface execution plan and cost.

checks: install: uvx postgres-mcp (Python package via uv/pip)
trust.notes: Community-vetted PostgreSQL MCP server. Defaults to unrestricted mode — configure a read-only database role for production use. Access-mode flag can be set to `restricted` for read-only queries only.
trust.securityNotes: Direct database access. Recommend using a read-only PostgreSQL role scoped to the target schema. DATABASE_URI is stored as a dmcp secret and never logged.
